blocking_findings.evidence: It pins/imports the R4 gate helper and its root-admission helper requires schema wnn.oldz4.student-cp1-terminal-gate.r4 and the R4 admission fields. The R5 validator emits wnn.oldz4.student-cp1-terminal-gate.r5.
blocking_findings.impact: The R5 runner cannot consume the R5 gate; it will reject it and/or re-enter the broken R4 validator. No full-valid export is runnable through this launcher as reviewed.
blocking_findings.issue: The R5 runner is byte-identical to the old R4 runner and imports validate_student_export_r4 at line 16.
blocking_findings.minimal_correction: Preserve R4, then create an identified successor runner that imports the R5 validator and explicitly binds the R5 gate/admission schema, receipt hash and CP1 hash before launching the exact predictor.

positive_findings: R5 validator uses fit_recipe_pins.split_manifest_sha256 and declared nested exposure fields, correcting the R4 KeyError paths while preserving the R4 contract bytes.

The R5 CP1 gate checks terminal attempt/source/admission bindings, fixed CP1 hash and epoch, provenance/hash/split membership, update counters, finite model/readout tensors, and training-state schema, epoch boundary, next_epoch=2, counters, required continuation fields and finite tensors.

The actual R5 producer receipt binds CP1 SHA 664643b2653a85d192f74a976d76afa933ae56c02b2621387d2f576fd61695eb, provenance/history, attempt terminal receipt, and training state; its declared gate status is pass and it makes no independent gradient-finiteness claim.

The focused R5 validator suite passed 12 tests; one opt-in actual-producer test was skipped (it requires WNN_RUN_ACTUAL_CP1_GATE=1). The separately recorded producer receipt is the actual-artifact evidence.

producer_gate.exposure: Previously inspected fold-0 development panel; not a fresh holdout and not public score evidence.
producer_gate.gradient_finiteness_claim: not independently measured; AMP skip counts are reported

remaining_qualification: R5 training-state validation confirms finite tensors and epoch-2 continuation boundary, but does not compare saved state.model tensors directly with CP1.model. The actual files were previously inspected and those model tensors are equal; record the omission as a state-to-CP cross-binding gap, not evidence of a bad checkpoint. Fixed-epoch inference is bound to CP1 itself.
Gradient finiteness was not measured; seven AMP-skipped updates are transparently reported. Do not convert this into a claim that every attempted gradient was finite.
The CP0 one-row compatibility receipt is only a separate feature-path smoke probe and is not the CP1 full-valid export.
required_next_step: A new runner/contract successor should consume the R5 gate, retain no-overwrite outputs and fixed epoch-1 prediction, and be statically/fixture reviewed before root export admission.
scope: Read-only review of actor R5 delta and its producer receipt. No fit, export, grade, GPU, provider, or admission action was performed.
